en.title: Earlier and Later Occurrence Flags
en.description:
For each position, flag whether its value appears at an earlier position and whether it appears at a later position, and return two binary strings. The current position itself does not count as an occurrence.

The input/output format was compiled by this site.
en.input: The first line contains n, followed by n integers. Recovered from the original snapshot: 1≤n≤10000, 0≤num[i]≤10000; the catalog mistakenly merged a line break into 10^40.
en.output: The first line holds the earlier-occurrence flags and the second line the later-occurrence flags; each line has exactly n digits.
en.explanation: Example 1 gives 00101 and 11000; a single element gives 0 on both lines; three 7s give 011 and 110.
hints: Do one forward scan and one backward scan, using a set to store the numbers already seen.
